questions.text:
P and Q are considering to apply for a job. The probability that P applies for the job is 1/4.
The probability that P applies for the job given that Q applies for the job is 1/2
, and the probability that Q applies for the job given that P applies for the job 1/3.
Then the probability that P does not apply for the job given that Q does not apply for the job is
questions.solution:
[latex]P(P\cap Q)=P(P)\,P(Q|P)=\frac14\cdot\frac13=\frac1{12}[/latex], and [latex]P(Q)=\frac{P(P\cap Q)}{P(P|Q)}=\frac16[/latex].

[latex]P(\bar P\cap\bar Q)=1-\left(\frac14+\frac16-\frac1{12}\right)=\frac23[/latex], [latex]P(\bar Q)=\frac56[/latex]

[latex]P(\bar P|\bar Q)=\frac{2/3}{5/6}=\frac45[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac45[/latex]

questions.text: If w, x, y, z are Boolean variables, then which one of the following is INCORRECT ?
questions.solution:
Simplify the left side of option 3:
[latex](w\bar x(y+x\bar z)+\bar w\bar x)y=(w\bar xy+\bar w\bar x)y=w\bar xy+\bar w\bar xy=\bar xy[/latex]

This is [latex]\bar xy[/latex], not [latex]x\bar y[/latex], so option 3 is incorrect. The other three identities hold.

Answer: Option 3

questions.text:
Given f(w,x,y,z) = [latex]\sum_{m}[/latex]
  (0,1,2,3,7,8,10) + [latex]\sum_{d}[/latex]
  (5,6,11,15), where d represents the don't care
condition in Karnaugh maps. Which of the following is a minimum product-of-sums (POS)
form of f(w,x,y,z) ?
questions.solution:
The zeros of f are minterms 4, 9, 12, 13, 14 (5, 6, 11, 15 are don't-cares).
- [latex](\bar w+\bar z)[/latex] is 0 when w = z = 1: covers 9, 13 (and don't-cares 11, 15)
- [latex](\bar x+z)[/latex] is 0 when x = 1, z = 0: covers 4, 12, 14 (and don't-care 6)

Together they cover every 0 and no 1.

Answer: [latex](\bar w+\bar z)(\bar x+z)[/latex]

questions.text: In a two-level cache system, the access times of [latex]L_{1}[/latex] and [latex]L_{2}[/latex] caches are 1 and 8 clock cycles, respectively. The miss penalty from L2 cache to main memory is 18 clock cycles . The miss rate of [latex]L_{1}[/latex] cache is twice that of [latex]L_{2}[/latex]. The average memory access time (AMAT) of this cache system is 2 cycles. This miss rates of [latex]L_{1}[/latex] and [latex]L_{2}[/latex] respectively are :
questions.solution:
AMAT = [latex]1+m_1(8+m_2\times18)=2[/latex] with [latex]m_1=2m_2[/latex]:
[latex]2m_2(8+18m_2)=1\Rightarrow36m_2^2+16m_2-1=0\Rightarrow m_2=\frac{-16+20}{72}\approx0.056[/latex]

[latex]m_1=0.111[/latex]

Answer: 0.111 and 0.056

questions.text:
Consider the recurrence function
[latex]T(n)=\left\{\begin{matrix} 2T(\sqrt{n})+1, & n \gt 2\\ 2,& 0 \lt n\leq 2 \end{matrix}\right.[/latex]
Then T(n) in terms of [latex]\theta[/latex] notation is
questions.solution:
Let [latex]n=2^m[/latex], [latex]S(m)=T(2^m)[/latex]: [latex]S(m)=2S(m/2)+1\Rightarrow S(m)=\Theta(m)[/latex].

[latex]T(n)=\Theta(\log n)[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\theta(\log n)[/latex]
